Here is the analysis of the README.md files for each of the 13 requested repositories located in `C:\Users\renu5\Downloads\find-skill-repo\all github repos`:

---

### 1. **ruflo**
- **Summary:** Ruflo is an agent meta-harness and execution layer for Claude Code and Codex that coordinates 100+ specialized agents, swarms, and persistent vector memory (AgentDB/HNSW). It automates multi-agent collaboration, background workers, and zero-trust cross-machine agent federation without manual orchestration.
- **Requires GPU:** **No** (Runs on CPU as a Node.js/Rust orchestration harness; optional GPU acceleration is available if routing to local models via Ollama/vLLM or RuVector GPU search).
- **Minimum RAM:** **~512 MB – 2 GB RAM** (standard developer environment).

---

### 2. **unsloth**
- **Summary:** Unsloth is a high-performance LLM training, fine-tuning, and inference platform available as both a web interface (Unsloth Studio) and a Python library (Unsloth Core). It accelerates model training up to 2x–12x while cutting VRAM usage by 70%–80% across 500+ text, vision, audio, and embedding models.
- **Requires GPU:** **Yes** for model training and full GPU acceleration (NVIDIA RTX/Blackwell, AMD ROCm, Intel Arc, or Apple Silicon via MLX), though CPU is supported for basic chat/data recipes and GGUF inference mode.
- **Minimum RAM:** **~6 GB – 8 GB VRAM** for fine-tuning smaller models (16 GB – 24 GB+ VRAM for larger models); **~8 GB – 16 GB system RAM** for CPU execution.

---

### 3. **comfyui**
- **Summary:** ComfyUI is a modular, node/graph-based visual AI creation engine for designing and executing generative workflows across image, video, audio, and 3D models. It offers granular pipeline control for architectures like Stable Diffusion, Flux, Wan, and Hunyuan with smart memory offloading and API support.
- **Requires GPU:** **Recommended/Practically Required** for standard generative workloads, though it can run on CPU using the `--cpu` flag (slow).
- **Minimum RAM:** **~1 GB VRAM** minimum with smart offloading (6 GB – 16 GB+ VRAM recommended for modern diffusion models); **~8 GB – 16 GB system RAM**.

---

### 4. **speech-to-speech**
- **Summary:** Speech-to-Speech is a low-latency, modular voice-agent pipeline (VAD → STT → LLM → TTS) exposed via an OpenAI Realtime-compatible WebSocket/WebRTC API. It provides swappable local and cloud backends (such as Silero VAD, Parakeet/Whisper, and Qwen3-TTS/Kokoro/Pocket TTS) for building real-time voice bots and robotic conversation systems.
- **Requires GPU:** **No** (supports CPU fallbacks for all stages), but a CUDA GPU or Apple Silicon (MPS/MLX) is strongly recommended for low-latency real-time performance.
- **Minimum RAM:** **~4 GB – 8 GB system RAM** for CPU-based pipelines / cloud LLM APIs; **~6 GB – 12 GB+ VRAM/RAM** if hosting local LLMs and TTS models on-device.

---

### 5. **OmniVoice**
- **Summary:** OmniVoice is a massively multilingual zero-shot text-to-speech (TTS) diffusion language model supporting over 600 languages with fast inference speeds (RTF ~0.025). It supports high-quality voice cloning from short audio references, attribute-based voice design (gender, age, pitch, accent), and fine-grained non-verbal expression control.
- **Requires GPU:** **Yes / Strongly Recommended** for practical inference speed (supports NVIDIA CUDA, Apple Silicon MPS, and Intel Arc XPU), though standard PyTorch CPU execution is supported.
- **Minimum RAM:** **~4 GB VRAM** minimum for GPU inference (tested on 4 GB Intel Arc A310 / consumer NVIDIA GPUs); **~8 GB – 16 GB system RAM**.

---

### 6. **ViMax**
- **Summary:** ViMax is an agentic multi-agent video generation framework that autonomously transforms ideas, novels, or screenplays into complete multi-shot videos. It orchestrates scriptwriting, storyboarding, multi-camera consistency checking, and video synthesis through an interactive TUI or pipeline scripts connecting to frontier generation APIs.
- **Requires GPU:** **No** (operates as a Python orchestration framework calling remote cloud APIs such as OpenAI, Gemini, Google Veo, Nano Banana, or Kling).
- **Minimum RAM:** **~4 GB – 8 GB system RAM**.

---

### 7. **graphify**
- **Summary:** Graphify converts codebases, documentation, PDFs, and media into queryable knowledge graphs and interactive HTML visualizations. It utilizes tree-sitter AST parsing and community detection algorithms to trace connections, shortest paths, and architectural relationships across ~40 programming languages without vector embeddings.
- **Requires GPU:** **No** (runs locally on CPU via tree-sitter AST; optional semantic passes on documents/media utilize assistant models or external APIs).
- **Minimum RAM:** **~2 GB – 4 GB system RAM**.

---

### 8. **Pixelle-Video**
- **Summary:** Pixelle-Video is an automated AI short-video generation engine and Streamlit WebUI that creates complete narrated videos with visuals, subtitles, and background music from a single topic keyword or script. It supports flexible atomic execution pipelines using cloud generation services (RunningHub, DashScope, OpenAI, Kling) or local ComfyUI workflows.
- **Requires GPU:** **No** dedicated GPU required when using cloud rendering or direct APIs; an **NVIDIA GPU (8 GB – 16 GB+ VRAM)** is required if running local ComfyUI image/video/TTS generation workflows.
- **Minimum RAM:** **~4 GB – 8 GB system RAM** for API/cloud mode; **16 GB+ system RAM and 8 GB – 16 GB+ VRAM** for local ComfyUI generation.

---

### 9. **Scrapling**
- **Summary:** Scrapling is an adaptive web scraping and crawling framework engineered to handle everything from single HTTP/stealth requests to large-scale concurrent crawls with pause/resume support. It includes built-in anti-bot bypass for Cloudflare Turnstile, automatic element relocation when page structures change, proxy rotation, and an MCP server for AI agents.
- **Requires GPU:** **No** (pure CPU-based Python library and headless browser automation).
- **Minimum RAM:** **~1 GB – 2 GB system RAM** for HTTP requests; **~2 GB – 4 GB+ RAM** when running concurrent headless Chromium/Playwright browsers.

---

### 10. **findskill**
- **Summary:** findskill is a Windows-compatible fork of the find-skills tool for Claude Code that fixes empty-output issues when searching for agent skills on Windows. It updates the skill instructions to execute search and discovery commands via PowerShell rather than standard Git Bash.
- **Requires GPU:** **No** (Markdown configuration and lightweight Node.js/PowerShell commands).
- **Minimum RAM:** **<512 MB system RAM**.

---

### 11. **gstack**
- **Summary:** gstack is an open-source suite of skills and structured workflow roles for Claude Code and other AI coding agents that simulate a full virtual engineering team. It provides specialized slash commands for product brainstorming, CEO/eng/design reviews, browser-based QA automation, security auditing, and release engineering.
- **Requires GPU:** **No** (runs on CPU as Markdown prompt definitions, Bash/TypeScript scripts, and Bun/Node CLI tools).
- **Minimum RAM:** **~512 MB – 2 GB system RAM**.

---

### 12. **handy**
- **Summary:** Handy is a free, open-source cross-platform desktop application built with Tauri (Rust + React) that provides private, offline speech-to-text transcription. It allows users to press a global shortcut, transcribe speech locally using Whisper or CPU-optimized Parakeet V3 models with Silero VAD, and directly paste text into active applications.
- **Requires GPU:** **No** (runs efficiently on CPU using Parakeet V3 or CPU Whisper via GGML/GGUF, with optional GPU acceleration supported).
- **Minimum RAM:** **~1 GB – 4 GB system RAM** (depending on the selected Whisper or Parakeet model size).

---

### 13. **agent-browser**
- **Summary:** agent-browser is a fast native Rust CLI and daemon designed for AI agents to automate and interact with web browsers via accessibility tree snapshots and refs. It enables AI assistants to open pages, click/fill elements, take annotated screenshots, execute JavaScript, and stream browser sessions with minimal token overhead.
- **Requires GPU:** **No** (runs on CPU using headless Chrome/Chromium automation).
- **Minimum RAM:** **~1 GB – 2 GB system RAM** for headless Chrome and daemon operation.
